A very beautiful view, but a disappointing price-quality ratio
Aug 2026 • Family
A very beautiful view, but a disappointing price-quality ratio

The view of the sea is undeniably the main asset of this restaurant, with direct access to the water's edge. But unfortunately, we liked the rest much less.

The whole thing seemed quite pompous and impersonal to us, with more of a "tourist trap" feel than a real charming restaurant. The five levels of tables in rows reinforce this feeling of a crowd and make the place lose a lot of conviviality.

The setting could be exceptional, however, but the very massive layout and the large number of tables take away, for our taste, all authenticity and all intimacy.

Added to this is a particularly high price with regard to the portions served, which we found quite ungenerous. The price-quality ratio therefore seemed frankly disappointing to us.

In summary: a very beautiful view, but a restaurant without real charm or soul, and above all much too expensive with regard to what is served. We clearly preferred other places on the island, simpler, more authentic, and much more pleasant.
